shortDescription: Work better with transporters to serve your customers.
fullDescription:
Transporters manage their vehicles and drivers. Their updates show which vehicles have room and where they plan to go, so you can plan more cost-effective shipments.

WORK WITH YOUR PRIVATE NETWORK
See the available space and routes your transporters share with your business. Authorized teammates can see available space, routes, and approximate locations on one map.

FIND VEHICLE SPACE
Search the Open Market by route, vehicle type, or available space. Open vehicle and provider details, then contact the provider to confirm availability and terms.

MANAGE VEHICLES AND SHARE CAPACITY
Transport providers can assign drivers, manage preferred routes, and choose which customers see each vehicle. Publish capacity to the Open Market, share it with your Private Network, or do both. Use phone location or ask Loadgistic to help connect compatible GPS.

TRACK AGREED SHIPMENTS
Follow shipment progress and proof shared with your team. Share an expiring tracking link and a separate code with a customer when appropriate. Permissions control who sees shipment information and location.

Available in English, Amharic and Afaan Oromo.

Phone location requires permission. Active shipment tracking may continue when the app is closed. Public Capacity shows approximate vehicle locations. Notifications are optional. Reviewed document badges identify completed checks. Arrange transport and payment directly with the provider.
